        SELECT f.message_id, MAX(CASE f.field WHEN 'subject' THEN 6 WHEN 'sender' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END) AS weight
        FROM message_fts f JOIN messages scoped ON scoped.id = f.message_id AND scoped.account_id = ?
        WHERE f.term >= ? AND f.term < ?

      ) t0 ON t0.message_id = m.id
JOIN (

        FROM message_fts f JOIN messages scoped ON scoped.id = f.message_id AND scoped.account_id = ?
        WHERE f.term >= ? AND f.term < ?

      ) t1 ON t1.message_id = m.id
      WHERE m.account_id = ?
     ORDER BY (t0.weight + t1.weight) DESC, m.list_sort_ts DESC, m.id DESC
